title: Password Strength Checker
description: Score a password from length and character variety with a local heuristic. The password is not uploaded, stored or checked against a breach list.
intro: Type a password to see a length-and-variety score, an estimated entropy figure, and which character classes are missing. Nothing leaves the page.
blurb: Score password length and character variety locally, without a breach lookup.
howItWorks: Type a password. It is read only from this page.
Press Score. The heuristic counts length and whether lowercase, uppercase, digits and symbols appear.
Read the band and the missing classes. This is not a breach-database check.
examples: password scores weak because it is short and one class.
Correct-horse-battery scores higher on length even without digits.
A 16-character mix of classes reaches the strong band.

faq.a: No. Scoring uses the characters in the field and does not call a server or a breach API.

faq.q: Does a high score mean the password is safe?
faq.a: No. The score is a local length-and-variety heuristic. Reused or previously leaked passwords can still be unsafe.
Each character class adds a pool size (26, 26, 10 or 33). Entropy is length times log2 of the pool. It assumes random characters, which real phrases are not.
